data.title: Microsoft plans to use fewer neoclouds as AI buildout shows signs of strain
data.description: Microsoft is winding down the number of neoclouds it counts as partners, picking key suppliers and focusing on its own data centers.
data.author: Jordan Novet,Seema Mody
